118 /**
119 * @brief Function call operator.
120 *
121 * @details The arguments (usually multi-dimensional indices) are passed to all the nda::Array objects stored in the
122 * tuple and the results are then passed to the callable object.
123 *
124 * If the arguments contain a range, a new lazy function call expression is returned.
125 *
126 * @tparam Args Argument types.
127 * @param args Function call arguments.
128 * @return The result of the function call (depends on the callable and the arguments).
129 */
130 template <typename... Args>
131 275320 auto operator()(Args const &...args) const {
132 275312 return _call(std::make_index_sequence<sizeof...(As)>{}, args...);
133 }
134
135 /**
136 * @brief Subscript operator.
137 *
138 * @details The argument (usually a 1-dimensional index) is passed to all the nda::Array objects stored in the tuple
139 * and the results are then passed to the callable object.
140 *
141 * If the argument is a range, a new lazy function call expression is returned.
142 *
143 * @tparam Arg Argument types.
144 * @param arg Subscript argument.
145 * @return The result of the subscript operation (depends on the callable and the arguments).
146 */
147 template <typename Arg>
148 10 auto operator[](Arg const &arg) const {
149 10 return _call_bra(std::make_index_sequence<sizeof...(As)>{}, arg);
150 }

175 4 [[nodiscard]] auto &operand() {
